tweet.text: That’s a misinterpretation. Had you been following me during the last several months, or if you’d bothered to do any kind of research, you would’ve seen that I am aggressively pursuing ways to keep the code, the design, and the architecture clean. This is essential, because the agents get just as confused by messy code as we humans do. It is not at all uncommon to watch them thrash and flail and give up when presented with a big ball of mud.
